summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, reporting that it posted an investor presentation on its website on September 14, 2026, for use at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference held September 14-16, 2026. The presentation, attached as Exhibit 99.1, is a routine investor-relations disclosure and contains forward-looking statements about prior acquisitions, subsidiaries, and business targets. No new special-situation transaction, terms, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. Investors should monitor the presentation for any updates to previously announced matters, but the filing itself does not constitute a new special situation.
